privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro: This policy explains how Uha stores your subscription data and what information is processed when you make purchases, create backups, search for services, convert currencies, visit the website, or contact support.
privacy_policy.collect_body: You do not need a separate Uha account, email address, or password to use the app. Your subscription data is stored on your device. Purchases, online searches, website visits, and support messages involve the limited data processing described below.
privacy_policy.local_body: Subscriptions, categories, payment method labels, preferences, custom logos, symbols, and notes are stored on your device. Payment method labels do not give Uha access to your bank or payment accounts. Uha does not ask for card numbers or bank login details. Exporting a file or creating an iCloud backup copies data to the location you choose. Currency conversion requests to sharkie.uha.app include the dates and currency codes needed for conversion, not your subscription names, amounts, notes, or tracked history.
privacy_policy.third_party_intro: Uha uses the following services for specific app and website functions:
privacy_policy.third_party_revenuecat: Validates purchases and access to Uha Unlimited. It processes a generated app user ID, purchase and receipt information, information about the purchase screen, and connection metadata. Purchase records also support RevenueCat's purchase analytics. Uha does not send RevenueCat the subscriptions you track in the app. Apple handles payment; I do not receive your card details.
privacy_policy.third_party_logodev: Search sends the text you enter and your selected sources to soup.uha.app. App Store searches can also send the search text and selected country directly to Apple. Depending on the source, lookups may include a domain, app identifier, country, or language. The catalog can use its own database, Brandfetch, Logo.dev, and app store data to return names, logos, and other service metadata. You choose the sources in settings; at least one remains enabled. These lookups do not send your subscription amounts, notes, or tracked payment history.
privacy_policy.third_party_cloudflare: The uha.app website, soup.uha.app service catalog, sharkie.uha.app currency exchange service, and related static assets are served through Cloudflare. Cloudflare provides content delivery, security, storage, and web analytics. It may process standard connection metadata such as IP addresses, request headers, timestamps, page URLs, referrers, and basic browser information to deliver content and stored files, prevent abuse, and provide privacy-preserving website analytics. See Cloudflare's privacy policy for details.
privacy_policy.third_party_outro: I do not sell your personal data. The integrations above are strictly functional and are not used to build advertising profiles.
privacy_policy.icloud_body: With Unlimited, you can create and restore a backup in your personal iCloud account from Uha's settings. The backup includes your database, settings, and locally saved images. You start these actions yourself; changes are not synced continuously. Uha creates and restores the backup file. Apple provides iCloud storage and its security protections, which depend on the iCloud service and your account settings. Apple's terms and privacy policy apply. I do not receive your backup contents.
privacy_policy.analytics_body: Uha does not use your locally stored subscription data to build advertising profiles or send it to a product analytics service. RevenueCat processes purchase information to validate and analyze purchases. The website and public APIs may process connection logs and use Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure traffic, maintain reliability, and prevent abuse.
privacy_policy.children_body: I do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has sent me personal information, contact mail@uha.app so I can review it and handle any deletion request.
privacy_policy.changes_body: I may update this Privacy Policy if my practices change. Updates will be reflected on this page with a revised date.
privacy_policy.contact_body: For privacy questions or requests about information held by me or Uha's service providers, email mail@uha.app. When you contact me, I receive your email address and any messages or attachments you choose to send. I use them to respond and resolve your request. Do not send card details or passwords. Only share a full backup if it is needed to investigate your issue.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of Uha, a subscription management application for iOS developed by Alena Dzhukich ("I", "me", or "my"). By downloading or using Uha, you agree to these terms.
terms.use_body: Uha is designed to track subscriptions, spending, and related records. Uha does not pay for or cancel the services you track; manage those subscriptions directly with each provider. Use it lawfully and do not interfere with the app or its services. Uha's source code and third-party components are governed by their applicable licenses; these terms do not remove rights granted by those licenses. The Uha name and branding remain the developer's property.
terms.subscriptions_body: The free plan lets you track up to 3 subscriptions, use the basic report currencies, and view forecasts up to 3 years ahead. Uha Unlimited is an optional one-time purchase that adds unlimited subscriptions, all supported report currencies, forecasts up to 12 years ahead, iCloud backup and restore, and restoration of local backups. Creating a local backup and exporting CSV files are free. All future premium features are included in Unlimited. Apple processes the purchase, and RevenueCat validates access. The price shown before confirmation depends on your App Store region. The purchase does not renew, and there are no recurring charges. Use Restore Purchases in the app to restore eligible access. Refund requests are handled by Apple under its applicable rules.
terms.content_body: Your subscription records and settings are stored on your device. You choose when to export them or create a backup. I do not receive your subscription data through these features. Keep backups of information you want to retain: deleting the app or losing your device can cause local data loss. Removing the app does not automatically delete exported files, iCloud backups, or App Store purchase records.
terms.icloud_body: With Unlimited, you can manually create and restore backups in your personal iCloud account. It is not a continuous synchronization service. Apple manages iCloud storage and security, and its iCloud terms and privacy policy apply. Availability depends on your Apple account, device settings, and available iCloud storage. I do not receive your backup contents.
terms.third_party_body: RevenueCat validates purchases and access to paid features. Service searches use soup.uha.app and, for App Store searches, Apple's services. The catalog can use its own database, Brandfetch, Logo.dev, and app store data. You can choose the search sources in settings, with at least one enabled. Currency conversion uses historical rates from sharkie.uha.app. Cloudflare provides delivery and security services for the website, public APIs, and related assets, and may provide website analytics. These providers have their own terms and privacy policies. Their services and data may change or be unavailable.
terms.termination_body: You may stop using Uha at any time. I may change or discontinue the app, subject to applicable law and your rights from an existing purchase. I will provide any notice required by law and aim to communicate significant changes in advance.
terms.disclaimer_body: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Uha is provided as is, without guarantees of uninterrupted or error-free operation. It is a tracking tool, not financial advice. Payments and forecasts are calculated from the information and schedules you enter; check them against your actual bills. Nothing in these terms limits consumer rights that cannot be waived under applicable law.
terms.changes_body: I may update these terms as the app or applicable requirements change. The revised version and date will appear on this page. I will provide notice and seek your agreement where required by applicable law.
terms.contact_body: If you have questions about these terms, you can reach me at mail@uha.app.

Search for
a service.

Spending.
Period comparison.

details.title:
Currencies, reminders,
and your data.
details.currencyBody: Use each subscription's original currency on either plan. Convert totals using historical rates when available. The currencies you can convert totals to depend on your plan.
details.remindersBody: Set reminders for upcoming payments and the end of a free trial.
details.organizeBody: Create and edit categories, payment methods, and services.
details.localBody: Your data is stored on your device, without a separate Uha account. With Unlimited, you can manually create and restore iCloud backups.
details.exportBody: Create a full local backup or export CSV files for free. Restore local backups and import CSV files with Unlimited.
details.appearanceBody: Choose a light, dark, or extra-dark theme.

pricing.title:
Free and
Uha Unlimited
pricing.body: Track up to 3 subscriptions free. Buy Unlimited once in the app to remove the limit and add iCloud backups, backup restoration, and a longer forecast.
pricing.backup: Local backup restoration and CSV import
pricing.note: Your regional currency is based on your App Store region or, if that is unavailable, your device region. Both plans let you record a subscription's original price in any supported currency. Unlimited pricing varies by App Store region. Purchase or restore Unlimited in the app.

export.label: Local backup creation and CSV export

pricing.supportBody: I’m building Uha on my own. The more people buy Unlimited, the more time I can put into new features, improvements, and the little details.
